add his name to the building._

Good morning! **Andrew** here. I hope you enjoyed your Labor Day holiday
weekend with friends and loved ones, got to touch grass, and did not spend too
much time online. Unfortunately, our president _did_ spend too much time
online.

In today's **' First Draft,'** we recap Donald Trump's latest unhinged weekend
posting spree, and we take a look at Rudy Giuliani's disgraceful, Islamophobic
attack on New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani ahead of this week's 9/11
anniversary. Let's read in.

This Labor Day weekend, Americans [paid](https://apnews.com/article/labor-day-
record-high-gas-prices-dffb7d3fa06ef930aaeebc380e5e4e0e) the highest prices
for gas they ever have at this point in the year, thanks in large part to
Donald Trump's failed, ongoing war in Iran. Trump, for his part, spent the
weekend
[posting](https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/posts/117230296511748912)
on his Truth Social platform, [multiple
times](https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/117230289219815718), about how
he is **" the greatest"** president in U.S. history.

Yes, better than George Washington, Abraham Lincoln, and Franklin D. Roosevelt
- that is what our deeply unpopular president thinks of himself. Who cares
that Americans [hate](https://x.com/FT/status/2096584268835065907) the job
he's doing?

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

And this delusional sentiment was _so, so far_ from the craziest thing the
president put on Truth Social as part of a posting spree that, in a more sane
political environment, would have lawmakers from both parties rushing to
impeach the president based on his obvious unfitness for office, or members of
his Cabinet invoking the 25th Amendment to remove him on the same basis.

Of course, we don't live in that world. Instead, our president screams his
insanity out loud on his social media feed, which he runs in partnership with
perhaps his most devoted and obsequious lackey, [Natalie
Harp](https://zeteo.com/p/how-stephen-miller-uses-natalie-harp) - and we must
simply live with the consequences of such behavior.

This is what it looks like.
